name: Grilled Sourdough Ham & Cheese
whyItWorks: Long-fermented white sourdough and naturally aged Swiss, Havarti, or sharp cheddar (~0g lactose) melt into a low-residue, high-protein hot sandwich with ~1g fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin-sliced deli ham and plain Swiss, Havarti, or aged cheddar between buttered white sourdough slices. Grill in a skillet or bake in the toaster oven at 375F until crisp and melted.
watchOuts: Unaged American cheese if lactose sensitive
